question: Who alone pervades all three worlds?
premises: no other is seen in three worlds
inference: Because no other is seen and the lord has inconceivable action with endless vigor, he pervades all.
uncertainties: fused sandhi forms are analyzed as given
plain_english: No other is seen in the three worlds; the lord of inconceivable action, endless vigor, and unmeasured valor pervades all, therefore he is all.
